reviews.t: Get salon hair doing it yourself
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:461e5ba1ab6dee83f1b318359711871f]] Love how I can get a salon hairstyle at my own finger tips.  The cost is higher than I’d like but I figure with how much I pay for blow outs it actually saves me money. If they would let me work for them I’d love to do PR.. and I’d be great at it because i have curly corse hair and with it I look like a different person when my hair is done.

I've always struggled with styling my hair.  This iron bends and makes waves my normally fine, limp, color treated, frizzy hair.  I couldn't live without it.  There is a learning curve but I watched a few YouTube videos and I was able to recreate the looks I saw.  I own two different sizes and I would recommend not dropping them on the floor because they seem a little "delicate" but this is pretty much the way it is with any styling tool. Got 2 nice curls out of it and then it died.  All I got after that were dashes.  I unplugged the iron and tried again and couldn't even get the temperature beyond 350 before it died again.

I have long hair and I’m learning how to make Beach waves. This tool does that but I feel like the curls don’t last that long . Not sure if the wand is made of a material/metal that really gets hot. I have a HOT TOOLs curling iron that makes curls that stay for hours.this wand seems to be made of a different metal. Kinda disappointed

This product works well. I like the really long cord and the upgraded features. The barrel is well made and gets hot without the burnt smell. The buttons make it easy to curl without your hand getting tired. I’ve been using this product a couple months now and I have noticed on more than one occasion I accidentally hit home and it starts spinning tighter to my scalp. I would use the iron the slow setting rather than fast and rather than pushing the button down continuously , do it intermittently until the hair is curled up as far as you want it. When I recieved it I took ot out of the box and plugged it in and it turned on and within seconds turned off. It did not work. I was very disappointed and returned it and got my money back. Decided not to get it again.

reviews.t: It's just ok and has a few hiccups
reviews.x: I am always in need of a good curling iron and this one is okay but it is a little bigger than I would like for it to be. I really love all the settings this one has. This has two buttons that control the temperature up or down and it has a little window to show what the current temp is. The maximum temperature is 350 and it reaches that rather quickly. It has a switch that controls the speed of the twirl low or fast. Then there is a button to control the direction you want to curl your hair lef

reviews.t: Like that the moving barrel switches directions
reviews.x: I bought mine in Dec 2019 and it is still working fine ( I saw some complaints about breakage). I would have liked a tapered barrel but refuse to purchase the super expensive brand. I learned to use a dryer brush so switching spin directions with the buttons was already in my skill set. The button to turn the barrel back to start position is in an annoying location but not a deal breaker by any stretch. I’m a designer but terrible at doing my own hair. This is a positive game changer for me.
THE UP AND DOWN HAIR DOWN BUTTONS ARE TOO CLOSE TOGETHER VERY EASY TO GET THE CONFUSED WHEN USING ON YOURSELF.  A REGULAR CURLING IRON DOES JUST WAS WELL IF NOT BETTER MAKING BEACH WAVES

I had a lot of hope for this curling iron because I love curling my hair but I'm not the best at it, so this looked like a great option. Unfortunately, it fell far short of my hopes and dreams.  The hair clips into a little clip at the bottom of the barrel. At first I thought it was genius, then I used it. I lost so much hair from that clip - my hair kept hooking onto it and pulling the hair out. And honestly, it didn't curl very well (my hair is just past my shoulders). I had to bring out my re
Sorry folks, this product needs tweaking. For the price I was disappointed. Not as easy to use as directions indicate.
I purchased this item and it came used. It was not in the package properly and clearly used.

reviews.t: love this, its durable and easy to use
reviews.x: im not good at curling  my hair and have been using this product for years and it works great for me. Its simple for me, i put the end tip of ur hair and press the button to roll it up, let it sit for 30 seconds and release. Its made curling my hair so much easier. I had the older version which lasted me a very long time but took it overseas to the UK and it stopped working once i plugged it in to their outlets, bought this new version which is supposed to be dual voltage in case i ever need it

This product creates soft wavy curls in no time and very easy to use! I love the options it provides - adjustable temp, rotates two ways, and a reset button to return the hub to starting position. I have thin/fine hair and some products burn it but not this one...this leaves it looking soft and smooth. Highly recommend.

I always had trouble curling my hair - until I found the beachwaver! Makes it so easy to get great looking waves. It is totally worth the money. Mine has held up well over time and I love it so much I bought another one in a different barrel size.

reviews.x: I bought it 2 days ago and was soooo excited to use it. Today was my second time using it and after literally 3 minutes it’s stopped working!!! The buttons aren’t responding and the on/off button keeps turning off the device! NOT recommended!

I really like the beachwaver. It makes it so easy to create beautiful curls.  Unfortunately the pin holding the clamp is starting to come out, so I need to make sure it is pushed in each time before I turn on the iron.
I have never once written a review for anything I have purchased. But this. This performed ONE CURL & IT STOPPED WORKING. ONE CURL!!!!! THIS PRODUCT IS JUNK!

claims.text: Several reviewers report the product breaking or malfunctioning shortly after purchase, including units that died within days or weeks.
Many reviewers praise the tool for creating salon-quality waves and working well on their hair.
Some reviewers find the product difficult to use, citing a learning curve and confusing button placement.
Reviewers frequently mention the high price, with some feeling it isn't worth the money.
A few reviewers note that curls don't last long or that the barrel doesn't seem to get hot enough.
